title: Markov — a Monte-Carlo Sampling Studio
description: Watch thirteen from-scratch MCMC samplers — Metropolis, adaptive, MALA, HMC, NUTS, Gibbs, slice, parallel tempering, the affine-invariant ensemble (emcee), the non-reversible Bouncy Particle sampler, the Barker proposal, curvature-aware Riemannian MALA (which finally beats Neal's funnel), and Hit-and-Run — explore nine tricky targets, including a real Bayesian logistic-regression posterior, in real time. Race two head-to-head on the same seed with a live ESS/efficiency/accuracy compare bar, auto-tune HMC/NUTS step sizes with Nesterov dual averaging, and share any experiment by link. Live diagnostics: ESS, split-R̂, autocorrelation, cost-aware efficiency, Monte-Carlo standard error, and total-variation distance to the true distribution with a signed shape-error heatmap. Long-exposure sample cloud and CSV export.
